about: Generated mood imagery for the Lady L Cannabis redesign pitch. Revision 1 (2026-11-04), design PASTE UP POP: mixed media, pop art and bento box on the brand lavender, sunflower, coral and sky blue. The eight category tiles, the home hero still, the guide flat lay, the paper collage texture (g-sunburst-wall) and the haze key frame (g-haze) were regenerated IN PLACE for revision 1 (same ids, files and aspect ratios) with defaults.style; the cut-outs, g-linen and the two Higgsfield stills are kept from revision 0 and were generated with defaults.styleRev0 (each sidecar records the exact prompt). Every image is AI-generated mood imagery only: none shows, or stands in for, Lady L's store, staff, customers, products, brands or any real place, and every alt describes what is depicted. fal entries run with: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project> --concurrency 4. Entries marked external: higgsfield-mcp were generated through the Higgsfield MCP (z_image) and labelled with tools/ai-label.mjs; reuse: true makes fal-gen skip them. Cut-outs (cutout: true) are generated on a plain background, then cut out with birefnet v2 (Matting) to a transparent PNG.

No people, no hands, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no signage, no brand packaging, every surface blank and unmarked, no brass, no gold metal, no velvet, no Art Deco objects, nothing candy-like, no alcohol, no vehicles, no neon, no iridescent or holographic finishes.
